checks.comparison: every ranked row carries a cost reference
checks.description: Cost-ranked rows without a unit cost cannot be priced.
checks.remediation: Add unit_cost to the ingredient master.

checks.comparison: every metric the registry promises to the dashboard is displayable
checks.description: The registry promises certain metrics to the dashboard. If their trust state no longer allows it, the values are withheld and the promise is out of date.
checks.message: all 7 metrics promised to the dashboard are displayable
checks.remediation: Widen the allowed trust states of the metric, or stop promising it in the dashboard.

checks.comparison: all dbt models built and all dbt tests passed
checks.description: A failed model or test means the warehouse does not match the contract.
checks.message: all dbt models built and all dbt tests passed
checks.remediation: Re-run dbt build and fix the failing node.

checks.comparison: demand denominator present for at least half the ranked rows
checks.description: A waste rate without a demand denominator is not publishable as a rate.
checks.remediation: Backfill sales for the affected days or publish the row as unverified.

checks.comparison: no duplicate sale_id
checks.description: Every sale line must appear exactly once.
checks.remediation: Re-run silver dedup on sale_id.

checks.comparison: no duplicate waste_id
checks.description: Every waste event must appear exactly once.
checks.remediation: Re-run silver dedup on waste_id.

checks.comparison: sales data at most 2 days behind the newest event
checks.description: Demand denominators must be current or rates are misleading.
checks.message: sales covers events and extends 12 day(s) past the newest event
checks.remediation: Re-run ingestion for the missing days.

checks.comparison: every published mart resolves to at least one source
checks.description: A mart without a resolved source cannot be traced back to a delivery.
checks.message: every published mart resolves to at least one source (2 declared model(s) have no delivery upstream)
checks.remediation: Check the model dependencies in the dbt manifest.

checks.comparison: every published metric is protected by an expectation or a dbt test
checks.description: A published metric whose source model nothing tests or checks is a number with no protection. It cannot be shown as measured.
checks.message: all 8 published metrics are protected by a declared expectation or a dbt test
checks.remediation: Add a dbt test or a declared expectation for the metric source model.

checks.comparison: every published metric has a definition, an owner and allowed trust states
checks.description: A metric without a definition cannot be trusted or explained.
checks.remediation: Complete the row in mart_metric_registry.

checks.comparison: no negative waste quantity
checks.description: Negative waste would be a sign inversion.
checks.remediation: Fix the source record; the contract quarantines these rows.

checks.comparison: rejected rows below 2% of the source
checks.description: A jump in rejected rows signals a broken upstream delivery.
checks.message: worst rejected rate 0.0000% on events, threshold 2.0000%
checks.remediation: Inspect data/quarantine for the affected source.

checks.comparison: mart waste cost equals cost recomputed from source rows
checks.description: Cost must be reproducible from the delivered rows and the ingredient master.
checks.remediation: Inspect the cost calculation and the ingredient master.

checks.comparison: mart waste quantity equals source waste quantity
checks.description: Aggregation must not create or lose waste quantity.
checks.message: waste_quantity: mart 296.94 vs source 296.94 (difference 0 kg or units)
checks.remediation: Inspect the aggregation grain in the mart.

checks.comparison: no silver source older than 3 days
checks.description: A stale silver layer invalidates every downstream metric.
checks.message: oldest silver source events is 0.08 days old
checks.remediation: Re-run the ingestion for the stale source.

checks.comparison: summary waste cost equals the cost of the ranked backlog
checks.description: The summary and the ranked backlog must price the same waste.
checks.remediation: Inspect the cost aggregation in mart_food_loss_summary.

checks.comparison: the published waste rate is a ratio of totals
checks.description: The published waste rate must be total waste over total demand. An average of daily ratios is a different number and must never be published under this name.
checks.remediation: Recompute the rate in mart_food_loss_summary as a ratio of sums.

checks.comparison: the estate total equals the sum of the locations
checks.description: The "all" row of the summary must be the sum of the per-location rows.
checks.remediation: Inspect the estate aggregation in mart_food_loss_summary.

checks.comparison: no duplicate grain keys
checks.description: Waste opportunity grain (waste_date, location_id, ingredient_id, waste_reason) must be unique.
checks.remediation: Aggregate to a coarser grain before publishing.

checks.comparison: all waste events resolve to location and ingredient
checks.description: Waste events must resolve to a known location, ingredient and cost.
checks.remediation: Add the missing reference row to the master data source.

metrics.caveat: Avoidability is a policy classification maintained in dim_waste_reason.
metrics.definition: Share of waste cost whose reason is classified avoidable or potentially avoidable.

metrics.caveat: Measured lift only. Forward-looking events carry no lift value. The demand index counts units sold, so it compares like with like across mixed products.
metrics.definition: Change in average daily units sold in the 7 days around an event versus the 17 days before it.

metrics.caveat: An estimate, not a measurement. Confidence is carried per event.
Planning heuristic. Not a forecast and not an order commitment.
metrics.definition: Cover days of average demand minus stock on hand.
Units of a product sold, as reported by the point-of-sale system.

metrics.caveat: Cost uses purchase-unit cost, not a landed or net-of-discount cost.
metrics.definition: Value of avoidable recorded waste priced at purchase-unit cost.

metrics.caveat: Sum of source-recorded quantity from fct_waste_events. No estimation is applied.
metrics.definition: Quantity of food recorded as wasted, in the unit of the ingredient.

metrics.caveat: The denominator covers the ingredients that were wasted, not the whole menu. Published only where a demand denominator exists.
metrics.definition: Total waste quantity divided by the total demand of the same ingredients, on the same days and locations. A ratio of totals, not an average of daily ratios.

dim_date.description: Conformed calendar. Grain: one row per date. date_key is a DATE.

dim_ingredient.description: Ingredient dimension with purchase unit and unit cost. Grain: one row per ingredient.

dim_location.description: Cafe location dimension. Grain: one row per location.

dim_product.description: Product dimension. Grain: one row per product.

dim_waste_reason.description: Waste reason dimension. Holds the avoidability policy and the prevention lever. Grain: one row per waste reason.

fct_demand_events.description: External demand event fact. Grain: one row per event (event_id). Attendance is an estimate, so the row carries a confidence class and a signal weight.

fct_inventory_snapshot.description: Inventory snapshot fact. Grain: location + snapshot_date + ingredient. A snapshot is a state, not a movement: summing it across days is invalid.

fct_sales.description: Sales fact. Grain: one row per sale line (sale_id). Measures: units_sold, demand_qty. Never aggregate this table directly; use the marts.

fct_waste_events.description: Waste fact. Grain: one row per waste event (waste_id). Measures: waste_quantity, estimated_cost. Reference coverage flags stay visible so orphaned rows cannot silently drop out of reporting.

int_sales_ingredient_demand.description: Ingredient demand by day, location and ingredient. This is the denominator for waste rates. Grain: sale_date + location_id + ingredient_id.

int_waste_with_context.description: Waste enriched with denominators, cost and avoidability. Grain: one row per waste event. Every join uses the full business key, so the model cannot fan out.

mart_demand_events.description: Event impact on local demand and waste. Grain: event_id + location_id. Forward looking events carry a signal but no measured lift.

mart_dq_expectations.description: Declared data quality expectations, versioned with the models they protect. The trust engine evaluates these after every build.

mart_food_loss_summary.description: Estate level food loss summary. Grain: location_id, plus one 'all' row for the estate total. Publishes the ratio of totals for the waste rate, never an average of per-row ratios.

mart_metric_registry.description: Registry of every published metric: definition, source model, measurement type and the trust states in which it may be displayed.

mart_purchase_plan.description: Purchase planning aid. Grain: location_id + ingredient_id. Recommendations are explainable heuristics, not forecasts.

mart_waste_by_category.description: Waste by ingredient category. Grain: category.

mart_waste_by_ingredient.description: Waste by ingredient and location. Grain: ingredient_id + location_id.

mart_waste_daily.description: Waste trend series. Grain: waste_date + location_id.

mart_waste_opportunity.description: Waste opportunity table. Grain: waste_date + location_id + ingredient_id + waste_reason. Carries coverage ratios so consumers know how much of the row is backed by a denominator.

mart_waste_priority.description: Ranked prevention backlog. Grain: waste_date + location_id + ingredient_id + waste_reason. Ranked by cost x avoidability x coverage, with a per-row trust state.

stg_events.description: External demand events. Grain: one row per event.

stg_ingredients.description: Ingredient master. Grain: one row per ingredient.

stg_inventory_snapshots.description: End-of-day stock on hand. Grain: location + date + ingredient.

stg_locations.description: Location master. Grain: one row per cafe.

stg_products.description: Product master. Grain: one row per product.

stg_sales.description: Point-of-sale unit counts. Grain: one row per sale line.

stg_waste_events.description: Recorded waste. Grain: one row per waste event.
